Edit target: the supplied existing companion sprite sheet. Preserve this character's EXACT identity, face, proportions, costume, materials, colors, front-facing camera and polished detailed pixel-illustration style. Replace its four-by-four layout with a production animation sheet of EXACTLY EIGHT columns and FOUR rows, 32 uniformly sized cells, wide 2:1 canvas ideally 2048x1024. Genuine transparent background, no labels, no grid lines, no text, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Retain color shading and clean soft alpha edges, NO forced low-resolution pixelation, no color quantization, no neon outline or stray artifacts.
Each cell has generous transparent padding, identical character scale and horizontal center; common ground baseline except the authored small hop. Full body and all appendages must fit inside each cell.
Row 1 = IDLE: 8 genuinely consecutive subtle poses: neutral alert, gentle breath, eyelids lower a quarter, lower halfway, closed briefly, half reopen, almost open, return neutral. Small secondary ear/tail/antenna motion appropriate to character; no whole-body drift.
Row 2 = GREETING: 8 consecutive poses, neutral, arm/wing/paw starts lifting, halfway lift, fully lifted, small wave outward, small wave inward, lowering halfway, neutral. Two-sided small increments, keep face consistent; NO motion lines or sparks.
Row 3 = HAPPY: 8 consecutive poses: neutral, pleased eyes, slight anticipation crouch, takeoff a few pixels, gentle apex, descend, soft landing, neutral. Body proportions and accessories remain stable.
Row 4 = RESTING: 8 gentle consecutive sleepy breathing poses: eyes comfortably closed, settled posture, subtle inhale, fullest inhale, pause, exhale, settling, matching first pose. Keep sleepy pose believable for this species.
Important: each neighboring cell is a real intermediate pose, not repeated identical drawings, not a different character. First/last poses of each row form a clean loop. This is a reusable production animation asset for an existing app; refine the reference, don't redesign it.
